name: Net measurement, and where the waste goes instead
name_zh: 工程量计算规则与净量原则
review_status: Drawn from the published national codes and from public statutory sources. Pending review by a Chinese cost engineer (造价工程师) before it is relied on for a tender.
references: GB 50854-2013 房屋建筑与装饰工程工程量计算规范
GB 50500-2013 建设工程工程量清单计价规范
description: Quantities in a Chinese bill are net, computed by the calculation code, and they are the same number for every tenderer. Waste, laps, working space and battering are not added to the quantity; they are priced inside the comprehensive unit rate. A tenderer who adds waste to the quantity has changed a number that is supposed to be identical across bids, and the bid is comparing against a different scope from everyone else's.
principles: The quantity is net per the calculation code, not the ordered or delivered quantity
Waste, laps, working space (工作面) and battering (放坡) belong to the rate
Reinforcement is measured by mass from the drawing, with laps per the code rather than per the site
Openings are deducted or not deducted per the code's own threshold for each item, and the thresholds differ item by item

precision.unit: 个 / 件 / 根 / 套 / 樘

practice_notes: The precision above is a rounding rule for the bill, not a tolerance on the measurement
Two bills that disagree on a quantity usually disagree about a deduction threshold rather than about the drawing
